result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For a small company, my top recommendation would be **BambooHR for overall HR management**, or **Employment Hero if you're operating in Australia**\.

The best choice depends on whether you mainly need employee records and leave management, or a complete HR and payroll system.

## Best HR software for small businesses (2026)

![Employment Hero Logo & Brand Assets (SVG, PNG and vector) - Brandfetch](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Z6qVhSSYF5CYFaR38tVZ9vpu364SrI1qcU-LhtFo5MrKvM2IIECP5NGDLvCA9qSi3OHN3nIGoWj3sOAoSGJ3TbpMzqye4Jq3Q2-1Ae4X05g3VDo154uJn7RkzUUAY3Xfi51rzm16rZPnUZ2NnrKj1KHaQU4ePGT94fhowd8mNNeyff58VJ3Le5GJh2e89NE4?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Employment Hero**

(Best Australian option)

- HR, payroll, onboarding and employee self-service.
- Leave management and compliance support.
- Designed for Australian employment requirements.

Website: [Employment Hero](https://employmenthero.com/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best overall HR platform)

- Employee records and onboarding.
- Performance reviews and reporting.
- Leave management and HR workflows.
- Easy-to-use interface.

Website: [BambooHR](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

- HR, payroll and IT management.
- Strong automation capabilities.
- Good for rapidly growing companies.

Website: [Rippling](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![HiBob Company Profile – Israel Office | Secret Tel Aviv](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VqtrRaPcgUicXO-4Ys0LiaPCrKe-5CJsa6TkSYgK1KcefpQhkEpEHerjMriA1N5YlEChNgmd7rQjSw27yQX48bFCzMJuRS79dEcVkcuDFBzyX6mwJYyF0haiasPADaDYIeAoykjLgSELovlBtSVFVxZrjW7VMjyk6qPW9KpNiwrWMbEgzHfDR3XQ7fQVHM0g?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. HiBob**

- Employee engagement and culture.
- Performance management.
- Useful for growing teams with managers and departments.

Website: [HiBob](https://www.hibob.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho People**

- Budget-friendly HR solution.
- Employee database and leave management.
- Attendance and timesheets.
- Good for businesses wanting essential HR without a large software bill.

Website: [Zoho People](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

## Which would I choose?

| Your priority | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Australian small business | Employment Hero |
| Simple, comprehensive HR | BambooHR |
| HR + IT automation | Rippling |
| Employee engagement | HiBob |
| Lowest-cost HR management | Zoho People |


**Important\:** If you're in Australia, check that the platform supports Single Touch Payroll (STP), superannuation, award interpretation where relevant, Fair Work requirements and Australian leave entitlements. US-focused platforms may not cover these requirements natively.
